data.title: HCL Infosystems shares skyrocket 20% to hit upper circuit after work order from Defence Ministry – check details
data.description:
HCL Infosystems shares surged 20 percent to hit the upper circuit at Rs 11.40 on Monday, November 23, after the company announced that its subsidiary has received a Rs 138.51 crore work order from the Ministry of Defence for the upgradation of existing data center network security systems.

HCL Infosystems share price today

The stock opened at Rs 10.72 on the BSE before jumping to its upper circuit limit of Rs 11.40. HCL Infosystems had closed at Rs 9.50 in the trading session.

At around 11.55 am, the stock was trading 19.79 percent higher at Rs 11.38. The company, focused on IT support services, legacy system-integration contract closures, and receivables and litigation management, commands a market capitalisation of Rs 374.31 crore.

HCL Infosystems share price performance

The fresh order boosted buying interest in the HCL Infosystems shares, which has rallied 16.14 percent over the past one week and 14.50 percent in two weeks, according to BSE analytics.

The shares have advanced 23.32 over the past month and 2.43 percent in the past three months. The shares, however, have declined 3.15 percent in six months and 14.51 percent, on year-to-date basis.

HCL Infosystem bags order from Defence Minister

In an exchange filing shared on Friday, November 20, HCL Infosystems said that its subsidiary HCL Infotech Limited, engaged in the business of systems integration, received a change request order worth Rs 138.51 crore under an ongoing contract with the Defence Ministry.

The order involves upgrading the existing data centre network security infrastructure. The project is domestic in nature and is scheduled to be completed by July 18, 2027.

The latest work order is a part of the HCL Infotech’s ongoing contract, which is valid till the year 2031.

“HCL Infotech is required to undertake the change request order for necessary upgradation to ensure that the systems remain robust, secure and operationally efficient,” said the company in the regulatory filing.

The company clarified that the order does not involve any related-party transaction and that there is no interest from related parties in the contract.

The additional order strengthens HCL Infosystems' ongoing engagement with the Ministry of Defence and is expected to contribute to its revenue stream as the project progresses.

data.title: ABB to Buy Germany's Ziehl-Abegg for $2.22 Billion
data.description:
By Adria Calatayud

ABB said it agreed to buy Ziehl-Abegg, a German manufacturer of fans, motors and ventilation systems, for $2.22 billion.

The Swiss engineering group said Monday that the deal expands its offering for heating, ventilation and air conditioning as well as industrial-cooling applications.

Ziehl-Abegg is expected to generate about $1.4 billion in revenue in 2026 and its products are used in HVAC, data centers, clean rooms, medical technology and elevator drives, among other uses.

The acquisition aims to add electronically commutated fans to the portfolio of motors and drives of ABB's Motion business, the company said. ABB said Ziehl-Abegg's profitability is expected to be in line with that of its own operations in the area within three years after closing of the transaction, which is anticipated in the second half of 2027 subject to regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.

ABB said it intends to retain Ziehl-Abegg's headquarters in Kuenzelsau, Germany, and that it will remain committed to the country.

Write to Adria Calatayud at adria.calatayud@wsj.com

data.title: Solana ETFs post $4.38 million weekly inflow as Bitcoin, Ether and XRP funds bleed
data.description:
US spot Solana ETFs pulled in $4.38 million in net inflows last week. Spot ETFs tracking Bitcoin, Ether and XRP all posted net outflows over the same stretch.

It is the first time in seven weeks that SOL funds finished a week in the green.

The inflow came during the trading week of November 16 to 20, 2026. It broke a run of six consecutive weekly outflows for the SOL products.

Those six losing weeks were costly. Combined net withdrawals over that period came to about $197 million.

Bitwise's BSOL did most of the heavy lifting. The fund took in roughly $6.08 million on the week, more than the category's entire net total.

Fidelity's FSOL logged the largest outflow among the SOL funds, at approximately $1.20 million.

Daily flows were choppy. Monday, November 16, delivered a $11.7 million inflow, and several outflow days followed later in the week before the tally settled at a modest net positive.

The price action was calm by crypto standards. SOL traded in a range between $70 and $73 during the inflow period.

Total assets under management for US spot SOL ETFs sat at around $965 million as of November 20. That works out to about 2.42% of Solana's market capitalization.

Since launch, the SOL funds have collected cumulative net inflows estimated somewhere between $1.41 billion and $1.65 billion.

The contrast with the larger crypto ETFs is what made this week stand out. Spot funds for Bitcoin, Ether and XRP all recorded net outflows in the latest reported weeks.

Bitcoin took the hardest hit. Some reports put weekly BTC ETF outflows at more than $1 billion.

Ether and XRP funds also saw money leave. Combined with Bitcoin, that left SOL as the odd one out among the major spot crypto ETFs tracked for the week.

One fund, BSOL, accounted for more than the entire net inflow, while FSOL lost money. That concentration means the turnaround leaned heavily on demand for a single issuer's product rather than broad buying across the category.

SOL ETF assets of around $965 million are a fraction of what flows through Bitcoin products in a single heavy week, so SOL fund flows are unlikely to move the overall ETF picture on their own.

data.title: Brookfield Agrees To Acquire PGP Glass From Blackstone For $1.7 Bln
data.description:
OTTAWA (dpa-AFX) - Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (BAM), an alternative asset manager, along with alternative investment major Blackstone Inc. (BX) announced that it has agreed to acquire PGP Glass, a specialty glass packaging manufacturer, from funds managed by Blackstone Private Equity for $1.7 billion.

PGP is a manufacturer of specialty glass packaging for cosmetics and perfumery, specialty food and beverage, and pharmaceutical industries, serving leading global brands in more than 70 countries.

Brookfield is expecting this investment to provide an opportunity to accelerate PGP's AI-led transformation across the enterprise including ways to enhance sales and operations planning, production efficiency and quality control.

The investment will be funded through Brookfield Capital Partners strategy and its affiliate Brookfield Business Corporation.

The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027.

In after hours activity, BAM shares were trading at $48.97, up 0.06% on the New York Stock Exchange.

data.title: Nio Sees Revenue Topping $15B This Year— But Analyst Warns Onvo Could Derail Tesla Roadster-Inspired Luxury Bet
data.description:
Key points:
  • Morningstar says Nio built its luxury image using Tesla’s Roadster playbook, but cheaper Onvo SUVs could draw buyers away.
  • Onvo’s five-seat L80 starts about $21,000 below Nio’s five-seat ES8.
  • Nio’s three brands outsold BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi individually in China for the first time in Q3.

Nio (NIO) CEO William Li said that the EV maker’s 2026 revenue will top $15 billion, while Morningstar warns that cheaper Onvo SUVs could lure buyers away from the luxury brand Nio built using Tesla’s Roadster playbook.

NIO’s U.S.-listed stock fell 7.9% to $2.45 on Friday, marking its lowest levels since April 2020.

Nio CEO Looks Past Selloff To $15B Revenue Year

Speaking to owners in Changzhou on Saturday, CEO William Li said that he judges the company by what it sells and earns. “Sales volume, revenue, gross profit, and profit are what’s real,” he said. “Nio’s revenue this year will definitely exceed 100 billion yuan [$15 billion].”

Nio reported 57.7 billion yuan in first-half revenue. If third-quarter (Q3) revenue comes in within its guidance range of 33.3 billion to 34.1 billion yuan, the company would need 8 billion to 9 billion yuan in the final quarter to reach Li’s milestone. Nio will report its Q3 results on Dec. 1.

Additionally, Li said that the selloff would not change how he runs Nio, Onvo and Firefly. “Our whole Nio team will definitely not simply cater to the capital market,” he told owners. “That’s neither necessary nor meaningful.”

How Nio Borrowed Tesla’s Roadster Playbook

Nio built its reputation for speed before it sold its first family SUV. Its Formula E team won the series’ first drivers’ championship, and its EP9 supercar set an electric lap record at Germany’s Nurburgring in 2017. By June 2018, buyers could take home a seven-seat ES8 carrying the same badge

“The approach is similar to Tesla’s branding strategy of releasing its Roadster sports car first, then expanding from high-end to the entry-level premium market,” Morningstar said. “Given Nio’s premium positioning and price ranges of major models, we think the Nio brand is perceived by car owners as equivalent to the premium image of BMW and Mercedes-Benz in the internal combustion engine, or ICE, market.”

By 2024, Nio was taking on Tesla (TSLA) more directly. It introduced Onvo’s first family SUV, the L60, as a rival to the Model Y. The lower-priced Onvo also gave families access to one of Nio’s signature services. At compatible stations, drivers could swap a depleted battery for a charged one.

Morningstar sees that kind of convenience as a selling point for younger drivers. “Younger-generation car buyers place a high value on in-vehicle technology and user experience, giving Nio a competitive advantage over traditional automakers,” the firm said. For Nio, the challenge is giving those buyers a reason to pay more for its flagship badge when Onvo offers some of the same benefits.

Morningstar: Onvo Could Lure Buyers Away From Nio’s ES8

Families shopping for a five-seat electric SUV now have two choices from Nio, priced 140,000 yuan ($20,965 ) apart. Onvo’s L80 launched in May at 242,800 yuan with an 85-kilowatt-hour battery. Nio’s ES8 followed in July at 382,800 yuan with a larger battery, dual motors, and 20-way adjustable front seats. Even the top L80, with Nio’s own assisted-driving chip and lidar sensors, cost 279,800 yuan.

Nio’s president said the price gap would help each SUV find its own buyers. The company even offered Onvo owners 10,000 bonus points to trade up to the ES8.

However, Morningstar sees a risk that shoppers eyeing the ES8 could choose the cheaper Onvo instead. “The launch of mass-market brand Onvo will impair Nio's premium image and dilute the company’s focus on the premium NEV segment,” the brokerage said.

Onvo Helped Nio Surpass BMW In China

Nio’s three brands outsold BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Audi individually in China for the first time in the third quarter. Nio, Onvo and Firefly posted 111,638 combined retail sales, ahead of BMW Group’s 107,210, Mercedes-Benz Group’s 99,592 and Audi’s 94,597, according to figures shared by Nio’s president.

The flagship ES8 still drew buyers at a premium. Nio said its latest-generation ES8 reached 160,000 cumulative deliveries last month and led retail sales among vehicles priced around 400,000 yuan in China through October. Meanwhile, the Nio brand delivered 18,125 vehicles, while Onvo accounted for 8,383 of the group’s 34,246 deliveries, nearly one in four.

What The Nio Badge Is Worth 

Morningstar’s bull case hinges on what buyers will pay for the Nio badge. “Nio has successfully built its premium brand image, which will differentiate the company from its mass-market competitors and generate extra pricing power for the company’s electric cars,” Morningstar said.

Nio said selling more of its higher-margin models helped lift its vehicle margin to 18.5% in the second quarter from 10.3% a year earlier. Its Dec. 1 results will show whether those gains held up in the quarter Nio outsold its German rivals in China.

Meanwhile, discounts could also squeeze those margins. “Intense competition in China’s auto industry will place pricing pressure on automakers. The company will need to offer promotions and discounts to consumers, which will weigh on its vehicle margin outlook,” the brokerage said.

The longer test comes when owners buy their next car. “While we applaud Nio’s success so far in establishing a premium brand in China, we think it is too early to determine whether brand loyalty will be maintained over at least a 10-year period,” the firm said.

How Do Retail Traders Feel About NIO?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment for NIO slipped to ‘neutral’ from ‘bullish’ levels a day ago amid ‘high’ message volume.

One user said, “$NIO He [CEO William Li] is right, if he did what would be best for investors they would have turned profits last year and would be a 30bill company today. But instead its 50% below 2018 ipo price”

View this Stocktwits post

Meanwhile, a bullish user said, “The fact that Li Bin isn’t putting financial resources in supporting the stock price to me is a good thing. I’ll be happy to continue adding.”

View this Stocktwits post

NIO’s U.S.-listed stock has declined 52% year-to-date.

data.title: BB Stock Rises Overnight: BlackBerry Takes On Browser Security With New Windows Launch Amid US Tech Outage
data.description:
Key points:
  • BlackBerry launched its Chromium-based secure browser for Windows, extending its mobile offering to desktops. 
  • It lets users access work apps like Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive on personal computers. 
  • U.S. intelligence chief Jay Clayton warned of more technology outages as organizations upgrade systems. 

BlackBerry (BB) stock rose overnight as the company said its secure Windows browser helps businesses protect work data without managing employees’ personal computers. The launch comes as U.S. intelligence chief Jay Clayton warns that technology upgrades could lead to more outages across critical systems.

BlackBerry stock traded over 3% higher overnight, ahead of Monday.

BlackBerry Bets On Workplace Applications And Secure Connectivity

On Friday, BlackBerry said its new Access Secure Browser for Windows uses Chromium technology to extend its enterprise security capabilities to desktop users. The launch builds on its existing iOS and Android offerings and replaces the previous desktop version.

This could make internal applications accessible from unmanaged Windows machines without needing companies to issue additional hardware. The Windows browser supports web applications, allowing services such as Outlook, Teams and OneDrive to operate in dedicated desktop windows.

BlackBerry Highlights Data Sovereignty Feature 

BlackBerry also highlighted the browser's deployment architecture as a selling point for government agencies, regulators and critical infrastructure operators. Many competing secure browsing products depend on cloud-based management systems operated by external vendors, raising concerns around jurisdiction and control.

BlackBerry Access operates within an encrypted BlackBerry Dynamics container and uses the BlackBerry Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) framework. Organizations running UEM on their own premises can retain browser administration, identity management, and security policies within their infrastructure.

BlackBerry’s Secure Communications division provides mission-critical software—including UEM, SecuSUITE encrypted voice and messaging, and AtHoc critical event management. In the second quarter, the division outperformed expectations, expanding 5 percentage points year-on-year to 66% and generating $9.7 million in adjusted EBITDA.

U.S. Intelligence Chief Warns Of More Tech Outages

BlackBerry’s update lands as U.S. intelligence chief Jay Clayton warned that technology outages could become more common as companies and government agencies upgrade older systems to improve performance and security.

A series of U.S. tech outages in November disrupted Microsoft services, air travel, major banks, and the National Security Agency. Most were caused by software errors, equipment failures, or efforts to upgrade old systems, not cyberattacks.

BB Stock: Retail Stance

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around the stock remained ‘bearish’.

A user said, “Between QNX, Secure Communications, government and defense contracts, automotive technology and the growing opportunity in physical AI, BlackBerry has multiple avenues for growth that the market hasn’t fully priced in.”

Another user said, “The previous CEO was laughably incapable of monetizing every opportunity handed to him on silver platters. Let's see if the current CEO can capitalize on a nation security and market meltdown episode.”

BB stock has gained 105% year-to-date.
